rules.text: If individual_use is enabled on a coupon, any other coupons already applied will be removed from the cart.
rules.quote: individual_usebooleanIf true, the coupon can only be used individually. Other applied coupons will be removed from the cart. Default is false.

rules.text: If free_shipping is true and the free shipping method requires a coupon, applying this coupon will enable free shipping.
rules.quote: free_shippingbooleanIf true and if the free shipping method requires a coupon, this coupon will enable free shipping. Default is false.

rules.text: To remove an applied coupon from an order without deleting the coupon itself, you must update the order's coupon lines instead.
rules.quote: To remove an applied coupon from an order without deleting the coupon itself, update the order's coupon lines.

rules.text: Batch operations are restricted by default to at most 100 objects created, updated, or deleted.
rules.quote: Note: By default it's limited to up to 100 objects to be created, updated or deleted.
